title: Bug Priority Rubric
description: Contract for the impact-to-priority rubric shared by /bug (filing priority), the severity-proportionate review criterion and /resolve-review's priority correction (#2992). One file, three readers, so the three cannot drift.

priority.description: Board priority alias as declared under .gh-pmu.json fields.priority.values.

precedence.description: How to resolve a bug matching several classes.

signals.description: Evidence a reader looks for in the bug's Description, Actual Behavior, Scope or Deployment Impact. Guidance for judgment, not a keyword matcher.

fallback.description: Priority used when the described impact matches no class. The reason is stated to the user rather than the choice being made silently.
